title: 题破山寺后禅院
titleEn: Written at the Back Hall of Poshan Temple
author: 常建
intro: An early-morning walk into an old mountain temple: a winding path, flowers and trees, birds, a still pool — and a silence so deep you hear only the temple bell.
analysis: 这首诗写诗人清晨游览破山寺（在今江苏常熟虞山）后院的所见所感。前两句写清早走进古寺，初升的太阳照着高高的树林。三四句是千古名句：弯弯曲曲的小路通向幽深僻静的地方，僧人住的禅房被繁茂的花木围着。五六句写山光让鸟儿也欢快起来，清澈的潭水倒映着天光云影，看着它，人心里的杂念也一下子消失了。“空”在这里是动词，意思是“使……变得空净”。最后两句写这里一切声音都静下来，只剩下敲钟、击磬的声音。用一点声音来衬托四周的安静，这种手法叫“以动衬静”：有了钟磬声，反而更显得山寺宁静。全诗写景清幽，又带着佛家“心静”的意味，读完让人心里也安静下来。“曲径通幽”今天还常用来形容园林小路，或比喻经过曲折才找到好地方。
analysisEn: The poet visits the back courtyard of Poshan Temple (on Mount Yu in today’s Changshu, Jiangsu) early one morning. In the first couplet he walks into the old temple as the rising sun lights the tall trees. The second couplet is the famous one: a winding path leads to a secluded spot, where the monks’ meditation rooms are buried among flowers and trees. In the third, the mountain light makes even the birds happy, and the clear pool, reflecting the sky, empties a person’s mind of clutter — here 空 (“empty”) works as a verb: “to make empty”. In the last couplet every sound in the world falls silent, and only the temple bell and stone chime remain. Using a little sound to bring out a great silence is called “setting stillness against movement”: the bell makes the quiet feel deeper. The scenery is calm and fresh, with a Buddhist sense of a quiet mind, and reading it slowly is itself a little calming. 曲径通幽, “a winding path leads to a secluded place”, is still used for garden paths, or for finding something good after a roundabout journey.
background: Chang Jian (708–?) passed the imperial exam in 727 but held only minor posts; he later lived as a recluse and wrote mostly about mountains, temples and quiet places. Little else is known about his life.
pronunciation: 曲径 qū；幽处 chù；禅院、禅房 chán（不读 shàn）；万籁 lài；此都寂：都 dōu；钟磬 qìng。
version: 采用通行本（《唐诗三百首》、教材通行文本）。重要异文：“曲径通幽处”宋本多作“竹径通幽处”；“万籁此都寂”一作“此俱寂”；“但余钟磬音”一作“惟闻钟磬音”“但闻钟磬音”。网站用通行的“曲径”“此都寂”“但余”。

lines.lit: In the early morning I enter the old temple;
lines.en: At first light I walk into the old temple;

lines.lit: the first sun shines on the tall woods.
lines.en: the new sun touches the tall trees.

lines.lit: A winding path leads to a secluded place;
lines.en: A winding path leads somewhere hidden and still,

lines.lit: the meditation rooms are deep among flowers and trees.
lines.en: where the monks’ rooms lie deep in flowers and trees.

lines.lit: The mountain light delights the nature of the birds;
lines.en: Mountain light makes the birds glad;

lines.lit: the reflections in the pool empty people’s hearts.
lines.en: the still pool clears the mind of every care.
Here all the world’s sounds fall silent;

lines.lit: there remains only the sound of bell and stone chime.
lines.en: only the temple bell and chime ring on.

words.note: 又叫兴福寺，在今江苏常熟虞山。
现代汉语说“朝阳”“初升的太阳”。
曲：读 qū，弯曲。径：小路，现代汉语“小径”。

words.en: to lead to a secluded place
words.note: 幽：幽静、深远。成语“曲径通幽”今天仍常用。
使……愉悦，现代汉语“喜悦”“愉悦”。
籁：声音。现代汉语“万籁俱寂”形容非常安静。
古义“只”，和今天表示转折的“但是”不同。
磬：寺院里敲击的铜制或石制乐器。

imagery.name: 钟声
imagery.zh: 在一片寂静中只听到钟磬声，用声音衬托山寺的宁静，也像在唤醒人心。
imagery.en: In the deep silence only the bell and chime sound out — the sound makes the quiet deeper, and seems to wake the mind.

imagery.name: 鸟
imagery.zh: 鸟在山光里欢快自在，写出自然的生机，也映衬人心的愉悦。
imagery.en: Birds happy in the mountain light show nature at ease — and mirror the poet’s own gladness.

imagery.name: 山
imagery.zh: 清晨山林里的光影和幽静，是让人放下杂念的地方。
imagery.en: The light and stillness of the morning mountain are what let the mind set its worries down.
